description: Mandatory immutable ledger tracking every deleted, unified, moved, or compacted function and struct.

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Hardcoded string literal representing an initializer list expression type in CallChecker, ConversionRankingEngine, SemanticHelpers, and HoverHandler.
entries.whyChangedOrDeleted: Replaced hardcoded literal string with canonical constants::k_initializerListTypeSentinel in Constants.h and ExpressionTypeCache.h to eliminate type-name hardcoding and maintain compiler parity.
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: Zero heap allocations; constexpr string_view sentinel comparison.

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Carried 13 boolean flags, 2 enums, and placement tracking taking 24 bytes.
entries.whyChangedOrDeleted: Compacted using C++20 uint8_t bitfields and enum narrowing to fit exactly into 4 bytes.
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: Compacted from 24 B to 4 B (-83.3% memory reduction, 2.0 MB saved per 100k instances).

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Stored raw parameter text (std::string rawText) and 9 individual bool flags taking 248 bytes.
entries.whyChangedOrDeleted: Eliminated rawText in favor of on-demand FormatParameter() formatting, and packed 9 bools into 1-bit bitfields.
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: Compacted from 248 B to 200 B (-19.4% memory reduction, 4.8 MB saved per 100k instances).

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Hot semantic model structures carrying unpacked booleans, default alignments, and nested signatures.
entries.whyChangedOrDeleted: Bitfield packing, reordered fields by decreasing alignment, and nested compacted SymbolModifiers.
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: FunctionSignature: 264->232 B (-12.1%); VariableSignature: 216->168 B (-22.2%); FuncdefSignature: 176->144 B (-18.2%); ClassSignature: 104->80 B (-23.1%); Symbol: 528->488 B (-7.6%).

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Lexical scope and local definition structures with loose padding and unpacked booleans.
entries.whyChangedOrDeleted: Packed LocalDefinitionKind and ScopeKind into uint8_t, reordered positions, and bitfield packed flags (isConst, isReference, isHandleType, hasNullInitializer).
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: LocalDefinition compacted from 208 B to 184 B (-11.5%, 2.4 MB saved per 100k instances); Scope compacted to 128 B.

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: AST node indexing span and table structures.
entries.whyChangedOrDeleted: Narrowed ContainerKind to uint8_t and packed IndexedContainerSpan to 20 bytes.
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: IndexedContainerSpan compacted from 24 B to 20 B (-16.7%).

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Ad-hoc local struct tracking isConst, isHandle, isReference qualifiers.
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: Eliminated duplicate struct definition and packed qualifiers into 1 byte.

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Ad-hoc local struct tracking isConst, isHandle, isReference qualifiers.
entries.whyChangedOrDeleted: Unified qualifier fields with canonical struct TypeQualifiers.
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: Eliminated duplicate qualifier flags and unified representation.

entries.whatItDidAndWhyInThatFile: Manual repetitive string searching for '@', '&', and 'const ' across type resolution passes.
entries.whyChangedOrDeleted: Replaced with precalculated Pass-1 bitfields (isConst, isReference, isHandleType) and zero-allocation constexpr helpers in TypeSanitization.h.
entries.ramOrCpuImpact: Zero string scans, eliminated CPU branch mispredictions and string parsing overhead.
